_about: Evidence dossier for every reference in cascade_kics_draft. Each claim pairs a sentence of the draft with a verbatim quote from the cited source. verify_references.py locates every quote in the cached PDF (pdfs/) and fills in its page; a quote that cannot be found is a failure. 'support' = direct: the quote states the claim; inference: the claim is our reading of the source (explained in 'note').

references.bib: M. Hasanain et al., "Overview of the CLEF-2024 CheckThat! Lab Task 1 on Check-Worthiness Estimation of Multigenre Content," CEUR-WS vol. 3740, pp. 276-286, 2024.
references.venue: CEUR Workshop Proceedings vol. 3740 (CLEF 2024 Working Notes)

claims.paper: CLEF 2024 CheckThat! Task 1 영어 (테스트: dev·dev-test·공식 test)
claims.quote: Task 1 involves determining whether a text item is check-worthy, with a special emphasis on COVID-19, political news, and political debates and speeches.

claims.paper: 출처가 겹치는[5] 영어 두 데이터셋 — CLEF 영어 데이터는 ClaimBuster에서 구축
claims.quote: As for the English subset, it was sourced from the annotated dataset described by Arslan et al. [4], and consists of transcribed sentences from candidates during the US Presidential election debates.
claims.note: Consequence: the two benchmarks share a source corpus. Our measurement (2026-09-27, text match against the Zenodo ClaimBuster release): 2,405/2,406 CLEF calibration sentences are ClaimBuster sentences; only 3/318 CLEF dev-test sentences match ClaimBuster text (0 ids); 313 of the 2,745 ClaimBuster 2016 test sentences also occur in the CLEF calibration set. No evaluation leakage, because each dataset is calibrated only on its own calibration set.

claims.paper: 테스트 = dev 1,032 + dev-test 318 + 공식 test 341 = 1,691문장
claims.note: Table 1, columns Arabic/Dutch/English/Spanish (Yes, No). English: Dev 238+794=1,032; Dev-test 108+210=318; Test 88+253=341; total 1,691 = our test set. Calibration comes from Train only.

claims.paper: 출처가 겹치는[5] 영어 두 데이터셋 — CLEF 테스트 문장은 ClaimBuster에 없던 새 문장
claims.quote: The English test set was constructed by manually annotating transcribed sentences that did not appear in Arslan et al. [4].

claims.paper: 온라인 허위 정보가 급증하면서 팩트체크의 중요성이 커졌으며
claims.quote: Due to the significant surge of disinformative content online the importance of improving the capabilities of fact-checking pipeline is paramount

claims.paper: 그 첫 단계는 사실 확인이 필요한 주장을 찾아내는 팩트체크 필요성 탐지이다[5].
claims.quote: the first part of the pipeline is finding claims that important to fact check

references.bib: P. Amatya, Venktesh V, and V. Setty, "Calibrating Small Language Models for Claim Check-Worthiness Detection," arXiv:2608.30731, 2026.
references.venue: arXiv preprint (anonymised ARR code link: likely under ACL Rolling Review)

claims.paper: 실제 팩트체크 서비스 운영사는 모든 문장에 대형 LLM을 호출하는 것은 실제 서비스 규모에서 감당하기 어렵다고 보고하였다[1].
claims.quote: invoking large LLMs on every incoming claim is prohibitive at production volumes

claims.paper: (운영사) — 저자들이 실제 서비스 운영 맥락에서 쓴 논문이라는 근거
claims.quote: This work is motivated by the practical demands of operating a commercial fact-checking service at an early-stage startup.

claims.paper: NN-PPI[1]는 소형 LLM의 점수를 라벨이 있는 보정 세트 중 의미적으로 가까운 이웃의 잔차로 보정한다.
claims.quote: For each test claim, we retrieve the k nearest neighbors to form a localized calibration set. The baseline LLM prediction is then adjusted using this set

claims.paper: NN-PPI가 이웃 검색에 쓰는 문장 임베딩(all-MiniLM-L6-v2)
claims.quote: indexed in a ChromaDB vector store using all-MiniLM-L6-v2 sentence embeddings (Reimers and Gurevych, 2019) with cosine similarity

claims.paper: NN-PPI는 원 논문의 Gemma 3 4B 설정으로 재현 — 샘플링 T=1.0, top-k=64, top-p=0.95 (scripts/score_gemma.py 기본값)
claims.note: Appendix C sampling table (model, temperature, top-k, top-p).

claims.paper: 원 논문 0.827, 0.760 (Gemma 3 4B + NN-PPI, k=10의 가중 F1; CLEF, ClaimBuster)
claims.note: Table 2, ClaimBuster block, Gemma 3 4B row k=10: Baseline 0.568, KNN 0.707, NN-PPI 0.760. CLEF block: see 1g.

claims.paper: 원 논문 0.827 (CLEF, Gemma 3 4B + NN-PPI, k=10)
claims.note: Table 2, CLEF 2024 block, Gemma 3 4B row k=10.

claims.paper: ClaimBuster(2012년 토론 보정 1,314문장, 2016년 토론 테스트)
claims.quote: We use 2012 election data for calibration and 2016 data for testing.

claims.paper: NN-PPI 재현 F1은 원 논문과 같은 CLEF dev-test 분할(318문장)에서 측정
claims.note: NN-PPI's CLEF test = 317 (107 CW / 210 NCW); this is the CLEF dev-test partition (108/210, see 5c), not the official 341-sentence test. Our 318 = the same partition.

claims.paper: 프런티어 LLM + NN-PPI가 원 논문에서 가장 강한 설정
claims.note: Table 2, CLEF block, Claude Opus 4.6 k=5: NN-PPI weighted F1 0.899 (0.925 class-0 F1) - the highest CLEF rows are frontier LLM + NN-PPI. That this is the 'strongest setting' is our reading of Table 2, not the authors' wording.

claims.paper: NN-PPI의 판정 기준 프롬프트로 채점; few-shot 예시 6개는 원 논문에 공개되지 않아 직접 작성
claims.quote: The {{examples}} placeholder is filled with 6 fixed few-shot examples, one per check-worthiness tier
claims.note: Figure 2 caption. The six examples themselves are not printed anywhere in the paper.

claims.paper: 원 논문과 같은 ClaimBuster 2016년 분할 (원 논문 2,740문장, 본 논문 2,745문장)
claims.note: NN-PPI Table 1: ClaimBuster test 2,740 (725 CW / 2,015 NCW). Our 2016 set built from the Zenodo release has 2,745 (728 CW); the 5-sentence difference is unexplained (likely de-duplication or parsing).

references.bib: P. Amatya and V. Setty, "Multilingual Fact-Checking at Scale: Fine-Tuned Compact Models vs LLMs," arXiv:2606.08605, 2026.

claims.paper: 같은 연구진은 소형 인코더가 확신하지 못하는 문장만 LLM에 넘기는 방식을 향후 과제로 제시하였다[2].
claims.quote: hybrid encoder-LLM systems that escalate to a generative model only when the encoder's confidence is low
claims.note: Stated in the conclusion as 'Future work will focus on ...'.

references.bib: Z. Wang et al., "Signed Rescue Routing: Harm-Aware Cascades for Efficient LLM Inference," arXiv:2609.07786, 2026.

claims.paper: 이 경우 교체는 분류기가 이미 맞힌 판정까지 틀리게 바꿀 수 있다. (2026-10-04 지도교수 ver.2에서 이 문장의 중복 인용 표시가 빠지고, 앞 문장의 [4]가 같은 출처를 가리킴)
claims.quote: it is harmful when the large model replaces a correct answer with an incorrect one
claims.note: SRR studies LLM-to-LLM cascades on MMLU/HellaSwag/ARC; our setting is classifier-to-LLM, so [7] is cited as consistent evidence, not as the same setting.

claims.paper: SRR[7]은 옳은 답을 뒤집는 손실까지 예측하여 넘길 입력을 고르지만
claims.quote: a budgeted routing method that predicts these two events separately and ranks requests by their difference
claims.note: 'these two events' = rescue (large model corrects the small one) and harm (large model replaces a correct answer), abstract.

claims.paper: 넘긴 입력은 큰 모델의 답으로 교체한다.
claims.quote: if g ≥τq then
claims.note: Algorithm 1, online routing: 'if g ≥ τq then return Mℓ(x) else return as' — an escalated request gets the large model's answer (replacement); Fig. 1 labels the same branch 'Final answer from Mℓ'.

claims.paper: 가벼운 모델이 먼저 판정하고 확신하지 못하는 입력만 큰 모델에 넘기는 구조를 캐스케이드라 하며, 흔히 넘긴 입력의 판정은 큰 모델의 판정으로 교체한다[5].
claims.quote: cascades answer easy requests with a small model and escalate selected requests to a larger model
claims.note: Abstract. Replacement of the escalated answer: claim 7c (Algorithm 1, 'return Mℓ(x)').

references.bib: Y. Zhang et al., "Calibration-Aware Uncertainty Cascades for Efficient Heterogeneous Model Collaboration," arXiv:2609.11446, 2026.

claims.paper: CAUC[5]는 넘긴 입력에서 두 모델의 출력을 결합하지만,
claims.quote: For deferred inputs, CAUC selectively combines model outputs when their predictions are complementary.

claims.paper: (CAUC 결과: 호출 약 절반 절감, 강한 모델 단독보다 정확도 향상 — 우리 결과와 같은 방향)
claims.quote: CAUC achieves an average relative accuracy improvement of 1.9% over strong-model-only inference while avoiding approximately 47% of strong-model calls

claims.paper: 결합 여부를 보정 세트의 검정으로 정할 뿐 결합 방식은 학습하지 않는다. 본 논문은 결합 가중치를 라벨로 학습해 LLM의 기준 차이를 반영한다.
claims.quote: This sign test is performed once on the calibration set and introduces no learned decision network.
claims.note: CAUC fuses standardized, temperature-calibrated logits weighted by each model's calibrated confidence (Eq. 6: z_fuse = (p_s q_s + p_l q_l)/(p_s + p_l)) and enables fusion only if a calibration-set sign test is positive. No fusion coefficient is fitted to labels. Our Eq. (1) fits (a, b, c) by logistic regression on labelled calibration data, so the fused score can re-weight an LLM whose decision criterion differs from the labels. The 'difference' sentence is our characterization based on these passages.

references.bib: F. Arslan et al., "A Benchmark Dataset of Check-Worthy Factual Claims," in Proc. ICWSM, vol. 14, pp. 821-829, 2020.
references.venue: Proc. Int. AAAI Conf. Web and Social Media (ICWSM), vol. 14, pp. 821-829 (Crossref)
